purpose: DSH Agent and human share one miniPaint editor document state

transport.preferred: request-response MessageChannel scoped to one editor frame
never: direct writes to project files or IndexedDB

identity.editorInstanceId: opaque id generated by editor on each mount
identity.documentId: opaque id stable for an opened project
identity.revision: monotonic integer incremented after every committed human or agent edit

safety.writeAtomicity: editor validates expectedRevision against the live document and commits the command in one serialized transaction; no host-side read-then-write check is authoritative
safety.idempotency: editor caches command outcome by editorInstanceId + commandId; duplicate apply returns the original result without reapplying
safety.timeoutSemantics: EDITOR_TIMEOUT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN means outcome unknown, not not-applied; caller must query editor.get_command_result using the same commandId before deciding next steps
safety.retryRule: never replay an unknown command; only retry a rejected command after the editor confirms it was not applied, using a new commandId for a corrected command
safety.revisionConflict: reject with REVISION_CONFLICT and current revision; never auto-rebase

history.agentMutation: must execute through editor-native mutation path and create one undoable entry
history.agentUndo: not exposed in v1; human invokes UI undo/redo
history.revisionOnUndoRedo: increment revision for undo and redo commits

non_goals_v1: pixel inspection or image bytes in tool response
